snippet.title: Coarse Blade - Atari 2600 Homebrew
snippet.description:
Terror reigns in The Old Kingdom. An evil sorcerer is ruling the land. Then one day, he is challenged by a barbarian Knight who is traveling from a foreign land to seek fame and fortune. You take control of the brave knight as you decide the fate of the Kingdom in this all-new Atari 2600 game.

Fight your way through the forest and conquer the three castles he occupies to overthrow the evil sorcerer and become the new king. 

Developed by Ketil Ronne
Download: https://magovinna.itch.io/coarse-blade
Also nominated for "Atari 2600: Best Homebrew Graphics (Original)" and "Atari 2600: Best Homebrew Music & Sound (Original)" at the 7th Annual Atari Homebrew Awards over at AtariAge.
